note: A VolumeData whose 2 x 2 x 2 voxels hold grey 0, 85, 170 and 255, drawn through an OpacityMapVolumeStyle whose 2D transfer function is a 4 x 1 picture (red, green, blue, white). X_ITE looks the table up at (r, r), the diagonal, so each grey picks one colour and the table's own alpha decides, so even the voxel 0 is drawn (red). Disabling the style leaves the default grey ramp (0 is transparent), and writing the picture again swaps the colours in the bridge (X_ITE 16.6.0 does not take the new picture: it keeps drawing with the colours the table had when the shader was built, so each engine is checked against its own value).
gaps: the 4.0 XSD lacks transferFunction in its containerField enumeration (the fixture is checked against a copy that has it)

only a PixelTexture is read as a 2D transfer function (an ImageTexture is not: the white texel stands in); a 3D transfer function (PixelTexture3D, ComposedTexture3D, ImageTexture3D) is read as X_ITE does, at (r, r, r)
X_ITE reads the table at (r, g) of the colour the default ramp already made, which is (r, r): the spec's intensity against gradient is not what 16.6.0 does and the bridge copies 16.6.0
a changed transfer function picture is taken up by the bridge and not by X_ITE 16.6.0 (measured: a PixelTexture image written after load changes nothing there, a toggle of enabled does not help)
the 2D transfer function repeats in X_ITE unless repeatS and repeatT are false: voxel 255 then lands on texel 0 (the fixture sets repeatS and repeatT to false)
